blocks.text: Settle in for the night with the GE-branded 4-Device Universal Remote in a classic black finish. No more worries about keeping track of multiple controllers. This universal TV remote can operate up to four devices, including your TV, Blu-ray/DVD player, streaming media player, cable, satellite, soundbar and more. Eliminate the hassle of managing more than one remote and enjoy having full control at your fingertips. Preprogrammed for immediate use with Samsung TVs and Roku boxes, this universal remote control offers simple, user‑friendly setup with your choice of automatic code search or direct code entry programming. The master volume control feature allows you to adjust the audio regardless of which device is being used. Full backlighting with soft blue LEDs gives you enhanced visibility when operating your remote in low-light settings. For added convenience, this universal TV remote control includes a Blu-ray/DVD player open/close button, simple menu navigation, a dot button for sub-channel access and a favorites button to store up to 10 of your most-watched channels for quick access. Organize your entertainment with this GE-branded 4-Device Universal Remote.

items: Multi-device control – Operate up to four audio and video devices such as your TV, Blu-ray player, DVD player, cable or satellite receiver, soundbar, streaming media player or other compatible devices

Best TV remote code library – Universal TV remote works with all major brands and supports thousands of the latest audio and video devices (not for use with radio frequency devices like Roku Streaming Sticks and Amazon Fire TV/Sticks)

Simple setup – Add two AAA batteries (not included) and enjoy easy automatic code search and direct code entry programming, as well as master volume control to adjust the audio no matter which device is being used

Preprogrammed for Samsung and Roku – Universal remote’s TV and STRM device buttons are preprogrammed for immediate use with Samsung TVs and Roku streaming media boxes (not compatible with Roku Streaming Sticks)
Fully backlit with a stylish finish – The classic black finish adds a classic look to any décor; blue LED backlighting helps you see each button easily in dark or dimly lit rooms
